title: NIST WebBook: Nitrogen is N2, molecular weight 28.0134 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Nitrogen as N2, molecular weight 28.0134 amu, CAS 7727-37-9.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Nitrogen, CAS Registry Number 7727-37-9, lists molecular formula N2 and molecular weight 28.0134 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 28.0061480096 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/N2/c1-2. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
